portable_capability_governance.classification_note: This file proposes a provider-neutral core revision. It is not itself an activated workflow, runtime adapter, provider probe, or portability receipt.

local_prior_lesson.gap_exposed_by_T550: The prior lesson requires semantic validation but does not yet force actual rendered-artifact validation before global-sidecar snapshot/install, distinguish intra-row rationale/defense aliasing, or reject stale primary IDs reused as current operational targets.

learning_event.trigger: A frozen 38-unit Hosea boss route and post-amendment preinstall checker passed, the book-local materializer rendered 38 chunks and packets while leaving global sidecars untouched, and the actual strengthened corrective-depth validator then found repeated semantic constructors. The first remediation proposal removed cross-row constructors in memory but failed fresh independent review because all 38 defensible_basis values aliased boundary_rationale and six canonical supports retained stale primary-route IDs as if operational.
learning_event.observable_success_required: A new rendered attempt must pass the actual three pre-sidecar gates, a fresh post-remediation independent checker, a newly hash-bound sidecar snapshot, atomic install, all five completion gates, and final independent postchecks.

stale_after_render_change_sidecar_snapsh.invalidation_rule: Any later route, materializer, validator, chunks, packets, relations, sidecar payload, or prose hash change makes this snapshot unusable for install.

root_cause_analysis.cause: Preinstall review inspected the frozen route and a read-only adapter projection but did not execute the actual corrective-depth entrypoint against materialized book-local chunk and packet bytes.
root_cause_analysis.lesson: Route validity and rendered-artifact validity are separate gates.

root_cause_analysis.cause: The sidecar snapshot was allowed before the rendered semantic gate was green.
root_cause_analysis.lesson: Snapshot and install evidence must be downstream of passing rendered gates and bound to the exact rendered hashes.

root_cause_analysis.cause: The remediation author's partial self-audit called selected detector helpers and optimized cross-row uniqueness, but did not run the full validator contract and did not independently compare field semantics within each row.
root_cause_analysis.lesson: A full entrypoint replay plus a fresh checker is required; helper-level green results are not a substitute.

root_cause_analysis.cause: Legacy HOS_MACRO and HOS_Q identifiers survived in canonical review prose after the active route had new decision, parent, and hold identities.
root_cause_analysis.lesson: Historical identifiers require structured, source-hash-qualified provenance-only records and may not function as operational targets.

root_cause_analysis.cause: The v1 lifecycle did not define one invalidation matrix spanning route, materializer, validator, rendered prose, postchecks, and sidecar snapshots.
root_cause_analysis.lesson: All downstream evidence must be revision-bound and fail stale on any upstream semantic or executable change.

subagent_replay_blueprint.shared_instruction_prefix: Candidate-only and non-authorizing. Agreement is evidence, never authority. Do not read sibling maps M1-M6, comparison synthesis, or T417 layers. Do not decide canon, theology, authorship, speaker identity, preferred translation, or source tradition. Preserve counterevidence and appeals; force no consensus. Original-language and internal cross-reference observations are evidence only. Write only the assigned non-overlapping artifact.
controller_rules: Freeze each blind primary before exposing any peer artifact.
Assign one immutable attempt ID and one exact output path per role attempt.
Record allowed and forbidden inputs plus input hashes.
Keep all specialist agents read-only except their one assigned artifact.
Root integrator alone renders book-local artifacts and installs shared sidecars.
A checker never edits the artifact it checks.
Same-model role separation is disclosed and weighted as one correlated model voice.

roles.instruction: Independently propose or assess passage units from the language-appropriate canonical text, discourse syntax, translation pressure, versification, and textual markers. Pin exact source spans or emit a structured source gap. Do not read other primary, peer, author, boss, or current rendered review artifacts.
roles.required_output: decision-local supports/challenges, exact source refs, counterevidence, confidence, and any translation/versification hold

roles.instruction: Independently identify the real literary form, child function, deciding scene/speaker/oracle/stanza/refrain/argument seam, strongest alternative, and parent hydration need. Do not use generic buckets or read other review lanes.
roles.required_output: exact-coverage candidate units with bespoke literary arguments and explicit alternatives

roles.instruction: Premortem prooftext, parent-loss, later-use, and internal-cross-reference risks. Treat every relation as evidence-only and non-directional unless the source explicitly supports more. Do not turn later reuse into a boundary or graph claim.
roles.required_output: risk docket, evidence-only relations, hydration requirements, and contested questions

roles.instruction: If and only if a pinned reviewed rabbinic, Second Temple, or ancient Jewish corpus and qualification receipt exist, report bounded context evidence with provenance. Otherwise emit a corpus-gap record and make no substantive ancient-context claim.
roles.required_output: qualified evidence rows or explicit corpus gap

roles.instruction: Crosscheck all frozen primaries for coordinate mapping, source simulation, marker strength, translation pressure, and false witness independence; issue challenge IDs with remedies.
roles.required_output: support/challenge mix, corrected mappings, and unresolved source questions

roles.instruction: Challenge non-unanimous seams and form labels, test larger coherent alternatives, and distinguish boundary disputes from internal presentation questions.
Challenge prooftext atomization, stale retrieval targets, parent hydration, and later-use authority leakage. Require active final IDs for operational recommendations.
roles.required_output: challenge ledger and executable active-target recommendations

roles.instruction: Answer every material peer challenge exactly once, accept/partially accept/reject/hold with cited evidence and counterevidence, preserve all losing positions append-only, and produce one provisional exact-coverage route without forcing consensus.
roles.required_output: challenge response ledger, candidate route, active identifier registry, and provenance-only lineage

roles.instruction: Read the author route but not boss output. Recompute exact coverage, source coordinates, mapping, markers, gaps, and simulation risk. Write blockers and mandatory boss carry-forwards.
Read the author route but not boss output. Audit bespoke prose, holds, appeals, hydration, active IDs, prooftext controls, and confidence distribution. Do not repair.

Rule on each decision and every challenge, preserve counterevidence and appeals, prefer the larger coherent unit when unresolved, hold only specific answerable seams, and emit active decision/parent/hold IDs plus provenance-only historical lineage.
roles.required_output: frozen adjudicated route and append-only dissent ledger

roles.instruction: Freshly recompute the boss route's exact source and crosswalk claims without writing route or render artifacts.
Freshly audit route forms, rationale, alternatives, holds, appeals, active IDs, and authority guards without rendering or editing.

After a preserved failed rendered receipt, propose the smallest scoped repair. Pin route, materializer, validator, rendered artifacts, and all projected hashes. Do not call selected helpers a full validation pass.

Do not author or edit the repair. Apply it to fresh copies, run the full validator entrypoints, check intra-row semantic independence and operational lineage, and compare all out-of-scope projections.
Re-read final rendered bytes and sidecar-bound hashes, recompute source locators and coverage, and report any mismatch without editing.
Re-read final chunks, packets, relations, appeals, sidecars, and active/provenance IDs; test bespoke depth and unresolved-hold integrity without editing.
Verify all five gates, both final postchecks, sidecar hashes, checker attempt inventory, candidate-only authority, and receipt-last prerequisites. Same-model evidence remains correlated.

exact_failure_mode_entries.observed_result: A frozen 38-unit route and post-amendment preinstall checker passed, but the actual rendered Hosea chunks and packets retained one chunk semantic constructor, three review constructors, two repeated review n-grams, and 38-fold maximum review-prose reuse.
exact_failure_mode_entries.prevention: Render book-local artifacts with global sidecars untouched, then run the actual corrective-depth, official map, and exact-coverage entrypoints before any sidecar snapshot or install.

exact_failure_mode_entries.observed_result: A read-only sidecar snapshot was green against rendered hashes that later required semantic prose repair.
exact_failure_mode_entries.prevention: Make a passing immutable rendered-gate receipt a prerequisite for snapshot creation; any rendered or executable hash change makes the snapshot stale and requires a fresh snapshot.

exact_failure_mode_entries.observed_result: A repair proposal made 38 rows cross-row unique by copying each boss rationale into defensible_basis, collapsing two required arguments into one while helper-level detectors appeared green.
exact_failure_mode_entries.prevention: Reject equality, full-prose embedding, and slot-masked equivalence between boundary_rationale and defensible_basis; require the full validator entrypoint and a fresh checker distinct from the repair author.

exact_failure_mode_entries.observed_result: Six canonical supports retained HOS_MACRO or HOS_Q identifiers after the active route had different parent spans and final hold IDs; accepted units could still read as pending.
exact_failure_mode_entries.prevention: Forbid stale source-primary IDs in operational prose and fields. Preserve them only in structured provenance_only rows bound to exact source artifact hashes and explicit active replacements.

exact_failure_mode_entries.observed_result: The r1 contract lacked one rule invalidating route checks, rendered receipts, checker verdicts, sidecar snapshots, and completion evidence after route, materializer, validator, or prose changes.
exact_failure_mode_entries.prevention: Use a revision-bound invalidation matrix; preserve old receipts append-only, rerun the affected slice, and block install or completion until every downstream binding is fresh.

residual_risks: The DAD graph is stale, so central deduplication and adoption remain unverified.
The exact provider-neutral identifier inventory mechanism still needs deterministic implementation and exploit fixtures across more than Hosea.
One Hebrew prophetic book does not qualify Greek, Aramaic, poetry, Gospel, epistle, apocalyptic, or whole-Bible behavior.
OSHB and UXLC remain correlated WLC-family views, not independent textual witnesses.
Same-model role separation remains one correlated model voice; cross-model convergence and human review are still required.
Ancient Jewish, Second Temple, and rabbinic claims remain blocked without a pinned reviewed corpus and qualification receipt.
